text: Three jobs today were rejected for one criterion whose evidence 'must cite commands that ran (D43)': in m988 and txka that criterion was 'cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass', which Athena's own checks stage already runs and records (e.g. 'checks fmt ok · clippy ok · test ok'). Each rejection cost a full retry. A criterion the checks stage already proves should count as evidenced by the recorded check results, or not be written as a criterion.
